description:
Use this when you need an auditable Saudi Arabia working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when financial-institution scope only. MHRSD business-sector leave, RTGS-specific intervals, government offices, private-employer rosters, Hajj-season branch exceptions and Umm al-Qura forecasts are not inferred.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range.
Example user requests: Count Saudi Arabia working days around SAMA Eid Al-Fitr interval. | Count Saudi Arabia working days around Friday/Saturday weekly baseline. | Count Saudi Arabia working days around National Day Saturday substitution.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-03-17","end_date":"2026-03-23","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/saudi-financial-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/saudi-financial-working-days-between.md
name: count_sa_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Exact SAMA financial-institution holiday intervals plus the annual National Day and Founding Day rules.

substitute_day_policy.description: SAMA states that National Day or Founding Day on Friday moves to Thursday and on Saturday moves to Sunday; the 2028 National Day substitute is included. Other employer or RTGS substitutions are not inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Saudi Arabia Working Days
